## SPI & Core Models
#38 adds specialized handler protocols for vector, graph, and event bus operations. #1128 replaces loose dict configs with strongly typed Pydantic models. #1088 adds OmniGate config and receipt models. #1250 deletes the legacy ModelOnexEnvelope class, consolidating the envelope surface. #1304 lands a SEA-generated todo-fixme-marker COMPUTE validator. #1476 replaces an author-identity check with a deterministic byte-compare for flip-bundle verification. #1627 discharges the enums shared-module escalation on structural proof of additivity.

## Delegation & Liveness
#3540 wires typed-decision shadow calibration and preserves incumbent decisions. #3595 validates complete delegation cohort keys before returning columns. #3661 adds onex models commands for adding, testing, listing, and removing models. #3665 introduces the automation-liveness contract, overlay, and event schema seam. #3246 lets measured class rubrics decide delegation acceptance. #3121 enables the free OpenRouter tier for review and reasoning with retries across free models.

## Nodes & Contracts
#3538 adds a worktree lease node that refuses a second lane in a held worktree. #3438 and #3443 add terminal_events declarations and walker tests for readiness and evidence pipeline orchestrators. #3642 adds a merge-order waits compute node. #3616 adds remote lane compute and effect nodes. #3652 adds a CI verdict compute node. #3149 ensures local rungs carry no lab model id and routes lane tenants to routing.

## Fixes & Testing
#3829 makes checks reject local contract prerequisites. #3363 fixes cursor-less exposures to serve newest rows and skips per-key scans for unique keys. #3484 keeps in-body provider 5xx failures retryable. #2875 re-runs receipt gates on ready_for_review to refresh draft-era reds. #3700 binds the ruleset half of AC3 to a live readback of dev's required contexts. #248 raises coverage of protocol_agent_ai_types to ~100%.

## Chores & Releases
#3669 renames the public repository reference to knowledge_base. #1174 and #312 bump dependencies for onex_change_control and omniclaude. #1722 releases omnibase_core 0.47.19.
